_note: One-line summaries for operations whose OpenAPI entry has no summary or description. The generator prefers the spec. Delete an entry once the spec carries its own summary.
verify_email: Check whether one email address can receive mail, including catch-all analysis.
enrich: Find a person's work email, mobile or profile from an email, LinkedIn URL, or name and company.
find_leads: Find people who match an audience description and filters.
find_intent: Find hiring, funding, news and job-change signals for a list of company domains.
check_companies: Answer one yes or no question about each company in a list, with evidence.
find_companies: Find companies that match a description and filters.
enrich_company: Get profile, technology, funding or relationship data for one company domain.
find_posts: Find social posts by topic, author or company, or the people engaging with given posts.
setup_sending: Quote, then buy after human approval, warmed domains and mailboxes for sending.
create_campaign: Create a draft email campaign with leads and sequence steps. Nothing sends yet.
add_leads: Add leads to a campaign. Adding to an active campaign needs human approval.
launch_campaign: Launch a draft campaign. Returns a preview first. A person approves before anything sends.
get_replies: List campaign replies, newest first. Free.
get_reply: Read one reply in full, including its body and lead state. Free.
set_lead_status: Record a lead's interest status, such as interested or meeting_booked. Free.
reply_to_thread: Reply in an existing thread. Returns a preview first. A person approves before it sends.
research_company: Run source-backed research on one company in the background.
prospect_picture: Build one picture of a person, a company, or both, in the background.
llm: Chat with a hosted model through Layrcake.
get_operation: Read the state, progress and result of a background operation.
